title: Own the M1 PR distribution and launcher implementation paths
goal: Provide unique exact path ownership for the M1.1 and M1.2 code and test portion of the M1 PR root plan-set.
acceptanceCriteria: RID-specific self-contained publishing and measurements satisfy the M1.1 Plan.
Installed launcher PackageRoot derivation and native apphost selection satisfy the M1.2 Plan.
Legacy distribution lifecycle and offline Companion regressions remain green.
No M1.3-M1.6 Target release workflow ruleset or remote implementation is included.
risks: A PR-level wrapper could obscure detailed child acceptance if reviewed alone.
decisions: Retain detailed child Plans and use this member only for exact PR path ownership.
